Pseudo:
```
class Solution {
    function abbreviateProduct($left, $right) {
        $arr = [1];
        $len = 1;
        $C = 0;
        $BASE = 1000000000;
        for ($i = $left; $i <= $right; $i++) {
            $mul = $i;
            $carry = 0;
            for ($j = 0; $j < $len; $j++) {
                $val = $arr[$j] * $mul + $carry;
                $arr[$j] = $val % $BASE;
                $carry = intdiv($val, $BASE);
            }
            while ($carry > 0) {
                $arr[$len] = $carry % $BASE;
                $carry = intdiv($carry, $BASE);
                $len++;
            }
            // strip zeros
            while ($arr[0] % 10 == 0) {
                $rem = 0;
                for ($j = $len - 1; $j >= 0; $j--) {
                    $cur = $rem * $BASE + $arr[$j];
                    $arr[$j] = intdiv($cur, 10);
                    $rem = $cur % 10;
                }
                while ($len > 1 && $arr[$len-1] == 0) {
                    $len--;
                }
                $C++;
            }
        }
        // convert to string
        $s = (string)$arr[$len-1];
        for ($j = $len-2; $j >= 0; $j--) {
            $s .= str_pad((string)$arr[$j], 9, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
        }
        $d = strlen($s);
        if ($d <= 10) {
            return $s . "e" . $C;
        } else {
            return substr($s, 0, 5) . "..." . substr($s, -5) . "e" . $C;
        }
    }
}
```

class Solution {
    function maximumBeauty($flowers, $newFlowers, $target, $full, $partial) {
        sort($flowers); // ascending
        $n = count($flowers);
        // cap at target
        for ($i=0; $i<$n; $i++) {
            if ($flowers[$i] > $target) $flowers[$i] = $target;
        }
        // k = first index with flowers[i] >= target
        $k = 0;
        while ($k < $n && $flowers[$k] < $target) $k++;
        // Now flowers[0..k-1] < target, flowers[k..n-1] == target (after cap)
        // prefix sums
        $prefix = array_fill(0, $n+1, 0);
        for ($i=0; $i<$n; $i++) {
            $prefix[$i+1] = $prefix[$i] + $flowers[$i];
        }
        // precompute pos for v=0..target-1
        $pos = array_fill(0, $target, 0); // if target=1, size 1
        $p = 0;
        for ($v=0; $v<$target; $v++) {
            while ($p < $n && $flowers[$p] < $v) $p++;
            $pos[$v] = $p;
        }
        $ans = 0;
        $cost = 0; // cost to complete suffix from m to n-1, starting m=k cost=0
        // iterate m from k down to 0
        for ($m = $k; $m >= 0; $m--) {
            if ($cost > $newFlowers) break;
            $rem = $newFlowers - $cost;
            // compute maxL for prefix length m
            if ($m == 0) {
                $L = 0;
            } else {
                $low = 0;
                $high = $target - 1;
                while ($low < $high) {
                    $mid = intdiv($low + $high + 1, 2);
                    // compute cost to raise first m to at least mid
                    $posIdx = $pos[$mid];
                    if ($posIdx > $m) $posIdx = $m;
                    $need = $mid * $posIdx - $prefix[$posIdx];
                    if ($need <= $rem) {
                        $low = $mid;
                    } else {
                        $high = $mid - 1;
                    }
                }
                $L = $low;
            }
            $total = ($n - $m) * $full + $L * $partial;
            if ($total > $ans) $ans = $total;
            // move to m-1: make flowers[m-1] complete
            if ($m > 0) {
                $cost += $target - $flowers[$m-1];
            }
        }
        return $ans;
    }
}
```
